name: trade-calc
description: 外贸报价、汇率与增值税计算器
author: Marcus

scripts.package:windows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-msvc.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-tauri.ps1 -Toolchain msvc
scripts.package:windows:gnu: npm run tauri:build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-tauri.ps1 -Toolchain gnu
scripts.package:macos: npm run check:versions && tauri build --bundles dmg
scripts.package:macos:universal: npm run check:versions && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles dmg
